coordinateReview.basis: 1280x720 actual Unity frame; normalize to the measured DOM canvas via the existing point() method.
coordinateReview.scope: Draft coordinates only. Existing story/book geometry remains separate. Camera-look and final 3D world route need Root/source review before sourceStatus may become frozen; no old image approval is reused.

nprRouteAdmission.scope: These are source-authored draft requirements, not observed control geometry or completed screenshots. Root must establish actual camera input and revise old fixed-axis travel/interaction steps from current Web play before sourceStatus can become frozen. Native15 selection never freezes this route.

mobile.formula: dxNorm=-47/(145*16/9); actual UI look input is multiplied by canvas.scaleFactor

obligations: Actual ordinary-input preview must establish these controls and measured frame geometry before authoring frozen steps.
If retaining old D/W fixed-world-axis travel segments, normalize from known default yaw before those segments.
Repeat after every fresh Boot/reload only when interactive field HUD resumes; a modal conversation/book must not be treated as an active camera.

Front/side orbit reviews also change heading: return to a known reviewed basis with ordinary input before any retained world-axis route; never blindly apply the47-degree correction from an unknown orbit.
Pending actual3D opening changes require source/route review before freeze. First-frame failed prototype is not accepted geometry or a rendered browser pass.
